01 · About

Who I Am

A quick introduction — fully editable from the admin dashboard.

I'm a 2nd-year Electronics and Communication Engineering student at Jai Shriram Engineering College, with a growing focus on embedded systems and IoT prototyping. I enjoy the space where code meets circuitry — writing firmware that actually moves, senses, and reacts in the physical world. Outside coursework, I've been building hands-on projects, completing industrial internships, and preparing for roles at embedded systems and manufacturing companies across South India.
